purpose: Compress the complete manual review of all 840 V19 development charts into one simple causal state-routed replay. This is a deeper, higher-breadth follow-up to the previously closed three-session quiet-inventory acceptance test: it uses the exact V24 dual-demand bull mother, adds the independent V13R1 bear-repair engine, shortens acceptance to one completed session to preserve opportunity breadth, and freezes lane-specific acceptance before replay.

observations: Bull winners usually converted the frozen platform high into accepted support quickly; bull losers more often jumped above it and promptly closed back inside the old inventory.
Synchronized bull demand tolerated an ordinary retest better than isolated information jumps; isolated jumps needed to retain the signal close because no broad demand confirmation existed.
Bear winners and losers both followed fast capitulation, but severe losers more often behaved as a single-session reflex rally that immediately lost the already-cleared prior-five-session high.
Requiring the next session itself to be positive would reject visible winners that consolidated above structure, so acceptance is defined against the pre-existing level rather than next-day return.
Fixed targets captured many economically successful moves before later reversal; no chart-derived trailing exit or discretionary hold extension is authorized.

frozen_plain_language_rules: At the mother-signal close, route causally: BULL uses the exact V24 quiet-platform dual-demand continuation mother; BEAR uses the exact accepted V13R1 fast-capitulation active-demand repair mother; TRANSITION holds cash.
The same causal market direction must still be present at the next completed market-session close; an engine-state reversal or missing state fails closed.

For a synchronized-majority-demand BULL signal, accept only if the immediate next market session is a valid completed stock session and closes at or above the platform high frozen before the signal. For an idiosyncratic-information-jump BULL signal, require the same and also a close at or above the signal close.
For a BEAR repair signal, accept only if the immediate next market session is a valid completed stock session and closes at or above the prior-five-session high already cleared on the signal day.

After the confirmation close, buy the first legal non-limit-up open within the next three market sessions. Keep the mother engine economics unchanged from the revised entry: BULL sells at +15% or the first legal open after H15; BEAR sells at +10% or the first legal open after H20; no stop; 40 bp round trip.

execution.entry: first legal non-limit-up open strictly after confirmation, no later than three market sessions

scientific_disclosure: All rule directions were generated after viewing outcome-labeled 2014-2020 charts. The replay is post-hoc development evidence, not independent confirmation.
